metadata.title: Kin — AI Personal Assistant in Telegram
metadata.description: Kin is an AI personal assistant that lives in Telegram and on the web. It reads your email, manages your calendar, files your tasks, and remembers everything — through natural conversation.
metadata.ogDescription: The assistant that actually does things. Email, calendar, tasks, and memory — handled from a Telegram chat or the web.

hero.badge: Talk to it like a person, not a prompt box
hero.description: Kin reads your email, checks your calendar, files your tasks, and remembers everything — right from a Telegram chat or the web. No app to learn, no dashboard to babysit.
hero.tagline: Free forever tier · No credit card · Lives in Telegram + web

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. Kin lives in Telegram (search @KinByPersonaliAI_bot or use the link after signup) and on the web dashboard. No app store, no extension.
Kin uses secure OAuth2 for Google and Microsoft — we never see or store your password, and you can revoke access at any time from Settings.

items.q: What happens when I hit my monthly limit?
items.a: You'll get a heads-up in chat with a one-tap upgrade link. Nothing is cut off mid-conversation.
Yes — plans are month-to-month with no lock-in. Cancel from the billing page in one click.
